text: オツキミ　やま　から　おりてきた　ばかりだが　まだまだ　げんき！

structure.jp: オツキミ　やま　から　おりてきた　ばかりだが
structure.en: I've only just come down from Mt. Moon, but

patterns.name: 〜たばかり
patterns.span: おりてきた　ばかり
patterns.explanation: ばかり after a past verb means the action happened only a moment ago. おりてきた　ばかり = 'just came down'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: くる added to a て-form verb shows the movement is toward where the speaker is now. おりてきた = 'came down here'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a statement means 'but' and leads to something contrasting. ばかりだが = 'I only just did, but…'
